forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {譲|ゆず}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To give precedence or make way for someone.
To pass ownership or responsibility to another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{譲|ゆず}った。
examples.english: I handed over the company to my son.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}った。
examples.english: I gave up my seat for an elderly person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{譲|ゆず}って⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather transferred the land to me.

notes:
{譲|ゆず}る means to yield, give way, or hand over something to another person.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る (A yields/gives ~ to B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る: to give way, yield the road
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る: to give up one's seat
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る: to hand over (succession)
- ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}る: to transfer rights
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{譲|ゆず}らない: not give an inch

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う→譲り合う：27835_yuzuriau⟧: to yield to each other, compromise
- ⟦{譲渡|じょうと}→譲渡：15629_jouto⟧: transfer (formal/legal term)

USAGE:
Commonly used on public transport signs encouraging passengers to yield seats to elderly or disabled people: ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{譲|ゆず}り⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧.
